summary: Welcome to Terra Nova: Space Mission Design Game! What if Earth could no longer sustain life? We imagined a future where humanity must find a new home beyond our planet. Through Terra Nova, players become space mission designers, using real NASA data to explore Mars and discover what it would take to make it habitable. Players can also explore other planets in our solar system, learning about their environments and possibilities. Terra Nova turns space exploration into an opportunity to discover, learn, and imagine humanity's future beyond Earth.
details:
Project Overview

Our project is a 3D space exploration and planetary restoration game where players take on the role of an astronaut searching for a new home for humanity as Earth becomes uninhabitable. Mars serves as the main destination. Players explore planets, gather resources, upgrade their spaceship, and unlock new areas through a solar system radar.

Benefits and Intended Impact

The game makes space exploration more engaging through interactive gameplay. It develops critical thinking, problem-solving, and resource management while introducing planetary science and space exploration. It also aims to raise environmental awareness and inspire students to learn more about astronomy and space technology.

Tools, Technologies, and Software Used

  • Godot Engine – Main platform for game development and gameplay.
  • Blender – For creating and editing 3D models.
  • Tripo AI – For AI-generated 3D assets.
  • Higgsfield AI – For visual and asset creation.
  • Claude AI – For coding assistance and troubleshooting.
  • NASA Resources – For scientific references and planetary information.

The game is primarily designed for PC/Laptop.

Creativity and Innovation

Our project combines planetary exploration, resource gathering, and spaceship upgrades into a story about humanity's survival. It also integrates AI-assisted tools with traditional game development to improve the creation of 3D assets and other game elements.

Factors Considered by the Team

We considered gameplay, graphics, performance, accessibility, scientific accuracy, and development limitations. We focused on simple controls, an organized interface, engaging exploration, and smooth gameplay. For our initial version, we aimed to deliver an approximately five-minute experience that introduces the story and main mechanics.

Overall, our goal is to combine education and entertainment while allowing players to explore the possibilities of humanity's future beyond Earth.
